Subject: Group office hours — coordinated demo lanes & fallback plan

Hi all —

Thanks again for your interest in a short group walkthrough of Redwood Inference. To make the session useful for multiple teams, we’ll split the 60-minute block into two parallel lanes:

- Lane A (Platform & Deployment): dedicated/hosted differences, Private deployment checklist, security callouts
- Lane B (Latency & Cost Ops): batching, caching, quantization, cost tuning and observable metrics

Proposed windows (PST):
- Option 1: Mon Nov 22, 5:30–6:30 PM PST (APAC-friendly for EMEA)
- Option 2: Tue Nov 23, 9:00–10:00 AM PST (NA morning)
- Option 3: Wed Nov 24, 12:00–1:00 PM PST (midday deep-dive)

If you can, please reply with your top two preferred options and whether you’d like to stay in a single lane for the whole hour or hop between lanes (we can accommodate short lane-switch windows at :20 and :40).

I’ll tentatively assign hosts once I hear back — Ben will own Lane B and I’ll lead Lane A; Marissa will own attendee coordination and follow-up notes.

Agenda (attached): short intros, 30m lane deep-dive, 20m guided Q&A/breakouts, 10m next steps + follow-ups.

Link to pick a time (if you prefer calendar): https://calendly.com/redwood-inference/group-office-hours?month=2026-11

Thanks — Vivek
--
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
